verses.author: model_A
verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Rain finds the window
where her thumbprint
still fogs the glass

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A porch light left on
for no one now—
moths keep the vigil

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The kettle forgets
it was ever asked—
still it sings for two

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
She counts the cups anyway,
sets one back—
the shelf remembers its shape

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The dog still waits
by the wrong door—
seasons turn, not habits

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Snow fills the footprints
before they're gone—
someone else's spring, arriving anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
A crow counts the footprints too—
finds none worth keeping,
flies anyway
